findings.title: Whitespace-only MCP credentials pass the form gate
findings.trigger: MCP step two is open and the user enters only spaces in the Tunnel ID and/or API key, then activates Connect harness.
findings.actual: The submit gate checks raw string truthiness, so whitespace is accepted and passed to setupMcp; failure is reported through a general error path without field-level invalid feedback.
findings.expected: Trim or reject whitespace-only values before submission, identify the invalid field, and keep saved credentials locked until explicit Replace credentials re-entry.
findings.smallestFix: Use trimmed values in the predicate and payload, add aria-invalid/aria-describedby, and show an inline error for values that trim to empty.

findings.title: Settings radio groups lack radio keyboard behavior
findings.trigger: A keyboard or screen-reader user focuses an Interaction mode radio or a Manual model profile radio.
findings.actual: The controls declare radiogroup/radio and aria-checked but use independent normal buttons with no roving tab stops or Arrow/Home/End handling.
findings.expected: One radio is tabbable and Arrow keys move focus and selection within the group; Home and End reach the bounds.
findings.smallestFix: Implement roving tabIndex plus APG radio-key handlers, or replace the custom group with a native grouped control.

findings.title: Custom language listbox lacks keyboard navigation and focus restoration
findings.trigger: A keyboard user opens Language in Settings, presses Arrow keys or Escape, or selects an option.
findings.actual: A listbox/option structure is declared without listbox keyboard handling or an active-descendant model; Escape and selection close the popup without returning focus to the trigger or exposing a focused save result.
findings.expected: Arrow/Home/End navigation works, Escape returns focus to the trigger, and selection returns focus predictably while an async update/error is announced.
findings.smallestFix: Use a native select or add listbox focus management, keyboard handling, trigger restoration, and an aria-live update/error status.

cleanAreas.note: Saved MCP credentials are locked behind an explicit Replace credentials action, with Keep saved credentials to cancel re-entry.
Verified MCP state has explicit Verify runtime and Done actions, with operation-aware verification status.
Browser capacity has bounded validation, disabled save state, ARIA invalid/described-by wiring, and saved/unsaved/error status text.
MCP busy guards, retry/error handling, and post-commit metadata refresh are present.
Responsive setup/MCP layout wraps controls and collapses fields for narrow content widths.
Tutorial video expansion has labelled modal semantics, Escape/close behavior, and playback-position preservation.
